description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “HP 35W Gulf Front Condo” a sun-soaked Gulf-front retreat in the exclusive High Pointe Resort. This 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo offers panoramic Gulf views, direct beach access, and all the comforts of home. Ideally nestled between Rosemary and Alys Beach, it’s the perfect escape for families or couples seeking both luxury and laid-back charm. From al fresco balcony dining to the lagoon-style pool and on-site Crabby Steve’s, every moment here is made for seaside bliss. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Prime Gulf-Front Location — Direct access to the beach with sweeping views from your private balconyResort-Style Amenities — Lagoon pool, hot tub, on-site dining, tennis, pickleball & moreAl Fresco Balcony Dining — Enjoy meals or sunset cocktails overlooking the GulfSpacious 2-Bedroom Condo — Comfortably sleeps 6 with two private en-suite suitesFully Equipped Kitchen — Generous counter space, storage, and bar seating for 3Private Laundry — Full-size washer & dryer included for your convenience*** LIVING AREA ***Unwind in the open-concept living space where the Gulf serves as your daily backdrop. Whether you’re relaxing on the sofa or stepping onto the balcony, this is the heart of your coastal getaway.Plush seating including a comfortable sofa and chairsFlat-screen TV for cozy movie nightsSliding doors open to a Gulf-front balcony with dining for 4Expansive windows that frame the sparkling emerald waters*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Prepare your favorite meals or enjoy fresh Gulf seafood from nearby markets. The kitchen offers both function and flow with an open design that connects to the living and dining areas.Ample counter and cabinet space for cooking and storageBreakfast bar seating for 3Dining table with seating for 4—perfect for family mealsOpen-concept layout that connects kitchen, dining, and living areas*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Enjoy restful nights and Gulf breezes from the comfort of two private bedroom suites, thoughtfully appointed with everything you need to recharge.Primary King Suite — King bed, flat-screen TV, Gulf-front balcony access, and en-suite bathroom with dual vanities and a walk-in showerQueen Guest Suite — Two queen beds, flat-screen TV, en-suite with single vanity & shower/tub combo, plus hallway access*** OUTDOOR SPACES & RESORT AMENITIES ***From sunrise to sunset, outdoor living is at the heart of your High Pointe experience.Gulf-front balcony with dining for 4 and panoramic water viewsLagoon-style resort pool with waterfall, kiddie pool & hot tubPrivate beach boardwalk just steps from the condoOn-site beachfront dining at Crabby Steve’sTennis courts, 4 pickleball courts, shuffleboard, and a children’s playgroundCharcoal BBQ grills and open green spaces*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***High Pointe Resort is perfectly positioned on 30A between Alys and Rosemary Beach, offering walkable access to boutique shops, local events, and family-friendly entertainment.Peddlers Pavilion — Just across the street! Enjoy food vendors, shops, and live musicRosemary Beach — Only a 6-minute walk to chic shops and charming cafésAlys Beach — Less than a mile away with stunning architecture and serene vibesCarillon Downtown & Market Street — 8-minute drive for more shopping & dining options*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel insurance is NOT included in our quotes but can be purchased during the reservation process or separatelyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentBicycle rentals are available through La Dolce Vita for an additional feeLSVs are not permitted in Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, or Alys BeachHigh Pointe HOA does not allow unregistered guests or outside visitors*** YOUR STAY – OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE ***TDT #: 204168
